new.name: OCR substitutes look-alike characters in engineering identifiers, ratings and values
new.lesson: Drawings and BOMs captured as images need a digital BOM/data table; OCR of dot-matrix/CAD fonts cannot be trusted for numbers; flag low-confidence numerics.
new.page_shows: Piping isometric bill of materials: 'FLANGE, RFWN, A105N, CL150', rating '150LB', 'GASKET ... PN20', 'FCS019-(2012)', 'ENBRIDGE'
new.output_says: 13 1 4 158LB FLANGE, RFWN, A185N, CL152, XS ... 'CASKET, SPWO' ... "FCS819-(2812)" ... 'ENBRIOGE'
new.why_it_matters: Pressure classes, material grades and specification numbers come out as different, valid-looking values (150LB -> 158LB, A105N -> A185N, 2012 -> 2812, gasket -> casket); search for the real spec misses and a reader or AI quotes a wrong rating; nothing flags it.
